conf.comment:
windows_powershell to OCSF pipeline.
Parses events, drops noise, maps to OCSF schema, and outputs compact JSON.

functions.description: Extract timestamp and structured fields from PowerShell log

add.name: host
add.value: ComputerName || undefined

add.name: dest_ip
add.value: ComputerName || undefined

add.name: user
add.value: User || undefined

add.name: event_code
add.value: EventCode || undefined

add.name: app
add.value: 'PowerShell'

add.name: vendor_product
add.value: 'Microsoft Windows'

add.name: severity
add.value: EventType == '1' ? 2 : EventType == '2' ? 4 : EventType == '4' ? 6 : undefined

add.name: action
add.value: Type == 'Information' ? 'success' : Type == 'Warning' ? 'failure' : Type == 'Error' ? 'failure' : 'unknown'

add.name: signature
add.value: TaskCategory || undefined

add.name: suspicious

conf.comment: --- STEP 4: Map fields to OCSF schema ---
Golden OCSF mapping — deterministic from canonical fields (no AI).

add.name: vendor
add.value: 'Microsoft'

add.name: product
add.value: 'PowerShell'

add.name: activity_id

add.value: (host) != null && String(host) != 'undefined' && String(host) != 'null' && String(host) != '-' && String(host) != '' ? (host) : undefined
